name: auf:method:finite-horizon-dcf@1
summary: Finite-horizon discounted cash flow with a fixed per-period discount rate and an explicit terminal value received at the end of the last period.

cashflows.description: net cash flows at the end of periods 1..n

rate.description: per-period discount rate as a decimal fraction

attribution.description: which interest the cash flows belong to

algorithm.description: value = sum over t = 1..n of c_t / (1 + r)^t, plus T / (1 + r)^n. Linear in the cash flows only while r and n are fixed.

assumptions: Cash flows are forecasts attributed to the valued interest; their basis is recorded under inputs of the receipt.
A single per-period rate applies to all periods.

composability.conditions: Additive across parts only when the parts' cash flows are attributed without overlap, internal transfers are removed, and the same rate and horizon are used; otherwise context-dependent.
